api/src/services/agent_executor.py.name: Agent conversations
api/src/services/agent_executor.py.description: Runs an AI chat from start to finish: sends the question to the model, carries out the tools it asks for and streams the answer back.

api/src/services/agent_router.py.name: Picking the right agent
api/src/services/agent_router.py.description: Chooses which AI agent should answer a message, either because someone named it or because it suits the question best.

api/src/services/agent_run_step_streams..name: Live run progress
api/src/services/agent_run_step_streams..description: Keeps each step of a running agent available so screens can follow along live, and clears the trail once the run is deleted.

api/src/services/agent_run_usage_summary.name: Run cost summary
api/src/services/agent_run_usage_summary.description: Totals what one agent run cost, how much room it used and how much of the repeated prompt it could reuse.

api/src/services/agent_runtime/__init__..name: Agent runtime core
api/src/services/agent_runtime/__init__..description: Gathers the building blocks every AI feature shares for talking to models, running tools and staying within limits.

api/src/services/agent_runtime/budgets.p.name: Run limits
api/src/services/agent_runtime/budgets.p.description: Caps what one agent run may spend on time and effort, and makes it finish with a handover note when the cap is reached.

api/src/services/agent_runtime/code_mode.name: Scripted tool use
api/src/services/agent_runtime/code_mode.description: Lets an agent run one short script that calls several tools at once, instead of a slow round trip for each tool.

api/src/services/agent_runtime/compositi.name: Agent assembly
api/src/services/agent_runtime/compositi.description: Works out exactly which tools an agent and its helpers may use for a run, and refuses anything the person asking cannot reach.

api/src/services/agent_runtime/empty_out.name: Blank answer guard
api/src/services/agent_runtime/empty_out.description: Catches a model that replies with nothing or repeats itself, tries once more, then hands the run off with a clear message.

api/src/services/agent_runtime/errors.py.name: Stopping a run
api/src/services/agent_runtime/errors.py.description: Signals that someone asked to stop an agent run, so the work halts where it is instead of carrying on.

api/src/services/agent_runtime/model_fac.name: Model setup
api/src/services/agent_runtime/model_fac.description: Connects a run to the chosen model with the right address, settings, thinking depth and prompt reuse.

api/src/services/agent_runtime/model_fai.name: Backup models
api/src/services/agent_runtime/model_fai.description: Switches to the next backup model when the chosen one fails, so a chat keeps working instead of showing an error.

api/src/services/agent_runtime/observed_.name: Model request record
api/src/services/agent_runtime/observed_.description: Records every request sent to a model service, so cost, speed and failures can be reviewed afterwards.

api/src/services/agent_runtime/retry_tra.name: Network retries
api/src/services/agent_runtime/retry_tra.description: Retries model requests that fail for temporary network reasons, without exposing private details in the logs.

api/src/services/agent_runtime/tool_poli.name: Automatic tool choice
api/src/services/agent_runtime/tool_poli.description: Decides how an agent finds the tools it needs on its own, including when to search for them rather than list them all.

api/src/services/agent_runtime/toolset.p.name: Tools handed to agents
api/src/services/agent_runtime/toolset.p.description: Gives an agent the tools it was granted and keeps oversized tool answers short enough for the model to read.

api/src/services/agent_runtime/usage.py.name: Usage figures
api/src/services/agent_runtime/usage.py.description: Reads the cost and hidden thinking effort that each model service reports for a request.

api/src/services/agent_stats.py.name: Agent performance figures
api/src/services/agent_stats.py.description: Adds up how often each agent runs, what it costs and how it performs, for the agent list and the fleet overview.

api/src/services/agent_write_policy.py.name: Agent edit permissions
api/src/services/agent_write_policy.py.description: Checks who may create or change an agent, and that every tool and reference it names is one they can use.

api/src/services/ai_behavior_service.py.name: AI behaviour settings
api/src/services/ai_behavior_service.py.description: Stores the shared AI settings that apply whatever model is chosen: the default instructions and how agents are run.

api/src/services/ai_model_service.py.name: Provider and model setup
api/src/services/ai_model_service.py.description: Manages the saved AI service connections and model choices, and which model is used by default in each area.

api/src/services/ai_usage_service.py.name: AI spend tracking
api/src/services/ai_usage_service.py.description: Records every AI request with what it used and cost, and totals spending per run, chat and agent.

api/src/services/anthropic_prompt_cache..name: Claude prompt reuse
api/src/services/anthropic_prompt_cache..description: Reuses a saved copy of a repeated prompt so Claude requests cost less, and steps back cleanly when that is refused.

api/src/services/capabilities/__init__.p.name: Agent capabilities
api/src/services/capabilities/__init__.p.description: Groups the shared way the platform names, finds and checks the actions an agent is allowed to take.

api/src/services/capabilities/catalog.py.name: Allowed action lookup
api/src/services/capabilities/catalog.py.description: Matches an action an agent asks for to the permission it holds now, and checks the arguments before anything runs.

api/src/services/capabilities/search.py.name: Action search
api/src/services/capabilities/search.py.description: Searches and ranks the actions an agent may use, so a long list can be narrowed down instead of shown all at once.

api/src/services/chat_artifacts.py.name: Files made in chat
api/src/services/chat_artifacts.py.description: Lets a chat create a document, spreadsheet, picture or video and attach it to the conversation for the user to open.

api/src/services/chat_attachments.py.name: Chat file uploads
api/src/services/chat_attachments.py.description: Accepts files a user attaches to a chat, stores them safely and passes them to the model with the message.

api/src/services/chat_errors.py.name: Chat failure messages
api/src/services/chat_errors.py.description: Turns a failed chat into one plain, safe message the user can act on, without revealing anything internal.

api/src/services/chat_runs.py.name: Chat replies in background
api/src/services/chat_runs.py.description: Starts, resumes, reads and cancels chat replies that keep working in the background, so closing a tab loses nothing.

api/src/services/llm/__init__.py.name: Model service connection
api/src/services/llm/__init__.py.description: Gives every part of the platform one shared way to talk to OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and similar model services.

api/src/services/llm/base.py.name: Conversation building blocks
api/src/services/llm/base.py.description: Sets the common shape of a model conversation, including messages, tools, files and replies, so every service behaves alike.

api/src/services/llm/factory.py.name: Model connection choice
api/src/services/llm/factory.py.description: Picks the model and settings from the saved profile, including its backups, and hands back a ready connection.

api/src/services/llm/provider_errors.py.name: Plain failure reasons
api/src/services/llm/provider_errors.py.description: Rewrites a model service failure as a short plain explanation an administrator can understand and act on.

api/src/services/llm/pydantic_client.py.name: Model call adapter
api/src/services/llm/pydantic_client.py.description: Lets older features keep making model calls their usual way while the newer agent engine does the work.

api/src/services/memory_requests.py.name: Run memory sizing
api/src/services/memory_requests.py.description: Works out how much memory a background run needs before it starts, learning from past runs and the machine's limit.

api/src/services/memory.py.name: Personal AI memory
api/src/services/memory.py.description: Stores the notes an AI keeps about a person between conversations, and lets them see, edit or delete what is kept.

api/src/services/model_capabilities.py.name: Model feature records
api/src/services/model_capabilities.py.description: Keeps an accurate note of what a chosen model can do, so chat only offers features that model actually supports.

api/src/services/model_catalog.py.name: Model catalogue
api/src/services/model_catalog.py.description: Holds the list of available models with their prices and abilities, kept fresh from the public catalogue.

api/src/services/model_pricing.py.name: Price and name lookup
api/src/services/model_pricing.py.description: Works out which company to bill and what a model is called and costs, so spending totals stay comparable over time.
